chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, who said: He who heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me:

Complete the prayer (salat) in four places: in the Sacred Mosque (al-Masjid al-Haram), the Mosque of the Messenger (peace be upon him and his family), the Mosque of Kufa, and the Sanctuary of al-Husayn (peace be upon him).

key_terms.تُتِمُّ: Complete (as in completing the full prayer rather than shortening it)
key_terms.مَسْجِدُ الرَّسُولِ: The Mosque of the Prophet (in Medina)

ai.seo_question: Which four locations are recommended for completing the full four-rak'ah prayer without shortening?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi highlights these four sites as the primary centers of religious authority in Shia Islam, linking the sanctity of the Prophet’s Mosque and the Kaaba with the spiritual legacy of the Imams in Kufa and Karbala. This ruling emphasizes the continuity of divine guidance through both prophetic and imamic shrines, reinforcing the theological significance of Karbala as a major locus of worship alongside the holiest cities.
